items.t: ARM Stock Gains 4% Since Q2 Earnings: Is it a Buy or Hold Now?
items.sum: Arm Holdings' 4% post-earnings stock gain reflects strong licensing demand and AI growth prospects, but weak cash flow and uneven royalties warrant a cautious Hold.

items.t: Arm shares slide as Nvidia succession search puts CEO Rene Haas in spotlight
items.sum: Investing.com -- Arm Holdings shares fell 6.5% on Friday, extending weakness across the semiconductor sector, with the decline accelerating after the Financial Times reported that Nvidia’s board had approached Arm Chief Executive Rene Haas as a potential successor to Jensen Huang.

items.t: Arm Posts a Record Quarter and Slides 12% as BofA Flags “Circular Financing Concerns”
items.sum: Key TakeawaysArm posted record fiscal second-quarter revenue of $1. 44 billion, up 27%, yet shares slid about 12% the next day as chip stocks sold off.

items.t: Arm Is Up 77% Even As Profit Fell

items.t: Server CPU strength persists as AMD and Arm gain share: UBS
items.sum: Investing.com -- UBS told clients in a note on Wednesday that demand for server processors stayed strong in the third quarter, with chips based on Arm (NASDAQ: ARM) designs and Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ: AMD) continuing to take market share from Intel (NASDAQ: INTC).
